info.title: API.SH: FBref
info.description: The FBref API from API.SH: public FBref data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: FBref competition season: table and squad stats
get.description:
A league or cup season: the league table (overall and home/away: rank, played, wins, draws, losses, goals, points, points per game, last 5, attendance, top scorer, goalkeeper) and squad standard, goalkeeping, shooting, playing time and miscellaneous stats for and against. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-competition

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Competition id (`9` Premier League, `12` La Liga, `20` Bundesliga, `11` Serie A, `13` Ligue 1, `8` Champions League, `22` MLS...) or a link to the competition.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season: `2024-2025` for split-year leagues, `2025` for calendar-year ones; default the current season.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer); default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-match

Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

get.summary: FBref player page: bio and every stats table
get.description:
One player's page: `bio` (`name`, `image`, `birth_date`, `facts` such as position, footed, born, national team, club and wages, every bio `lines`, `social` links and `achievements`), `schema` (structured person data) and every table (last 5 matches, standard stats, shooting, playing time and miscellaneous stats by season for domestic leagues, cups, international cups and the national team, wages). Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-player

parameters.description: Player id (`e342ad68`, 8 characters) or a link to the player page.

parameters.name: tables
parameters.description: Comma-separated table ids to return (see `table_ids` in any answer); default every table on the page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: FBref player match logs for a season

Every match of a player's season, one row per match: date, competition, round, venue, result, squad, opponent, start, position, minutes, goals, assists, shots, cards and the other stats of the chosen type. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-player-matchlogs

get.description:
Search FBref by name: players, clubs, competitions and other pages, grouped in `sections` (`section`, `label`, `count`, `items` with `name`, `url`, `id` and the extra lines the site shows). When the name has one exact match the site jumps to, `sections` holds that one page (`section` `exact`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-search

get.summary: FBref club season: squad stats and match log
get.description:
A club's season page: `bio` (record, manager, captain and other facts), squad standard, goalkeeping, shooting, playing time and miscellaneous stats per player, the scores and fixtures with results, and the league table rows. Each table: `id`, `title`, `columns` (key and label) and `rows` keyed by column (numbers parsed; a linked cell adds `<column>_url`, a player cell `<column>_id`), plus `footer` rows (career or team totals) where the page has them. `table_ids` lists every table on the page; pass `tables` to get only some.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fbref-squad

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
